name: aa-deploy-runner
//: The AA console/deploy runner's OWN dependency tree. It is a separate process from the
kernel and does not share its lockfile, so this list is maintained here rather than
inherited. What MUST agree with the kernel pin
(effectstream/zswap-offerfiles-kernel @ 4af102536f02f137b696a4734bd8c936eddf3672,
branch ledger-v9 / PR #65) is what crosses the wire between them:
@midnightntwrk/ledger-v9 1.0.0-rc.3 (the offer blob's ledger types),
@effectstream/mip-zswap-offer 0.4.0-v9.0 (the MIP-0005 encoding the kernel parses),
and @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime 0.18.0-rc.1 next to compactc 0.33.0-rc.2, which is
the version the pinned kernel tree declares in infra/compact-version.txt and which the
image reads from there rather than hard-coding.
compact-runtime 0.18.0-rc.1 STILL FITS at AA_REF 41de69d (the split preset): measured
2026-09-04, compactc 0.33.0-rc.2 compiles the preset plus its nine modules and stamps
runtime-version 0.18.0-rc.1, and emits ZKIR byte-identical to compactc 0.34.0 for all
nine circuits. The MinoCrab release supplies execute's ZKIR and keys instead of that
build (see the image Dockerfile) but adds NO dependency here: it is data, not code.
@effectstream/midnight-contracts and @effectstream/utils stay at 0.200.1 here while the
kernel resolves 0.200.2: they are used for this process's own network config and
contract helpers, never for anything the kernel deserializes.
The override collapses ledger-v9 to ONE wasm copy — two copies in one process fail
instanceof checks (the documented trap).
